The '''iris''' was a type of [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. One type of iris, the [[Rigelian Iris]], could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rigel VII|Rigel 7]], noted for its ability to seemingly open up at the touch of of a [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name=Yoda">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' {{Ab|Yoda: Dark Rendezvous (unabridged audiobook)}}</ref>
